list: Official 55 trophies — names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them [S4]; guides, steps and flags written for this entry and cited per step.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; there is no separate task. Plan the run around the two golds — the finale and 100% completion — and treat everything else as stages of one route [S3][S42]. The roadmap tab in this guide orders all 54 so nothing missable is left behind.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically with the last of them.
Follow the roadmap stages in order: story first, then strands, activities, collectibles, money, and the 100% cleanup last.
Clear the six flagged missables before starting the final mission — the finale locks partner free-roam until the post-game.
Keep one rolling save outside the autosave slot before every chapter end, so a missed flag is a reload, not a restart.
Expect 120-160 hours; the long poles are 100% completion, 250 stunts and the two big location grinds (cards, WAiNK).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission: it introduces Jason on the Leonida Keys, the boat controls and the partner-switch prompt, and it cannot be failed forward — the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen [S1][S6]. Play it blind; nothing later depends on choices made here.

steps.t: Start a new game and play the prologue on the Keys; follow the tutorial prompts for driving, boating and cover.
When the fishing trip turns, stay in cover and let the tutorial teach Combat Focus before pushing forward.
Finish the boat escape back to the dock; the trophy unlocks as the title card lands.
Do not skip the cutscenes on a first run — two later trophies (Personal Best, In The Beginning…) grow out of beats set up here.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 reunites Lucia and Jason and opens Vice City proper. It is fully linear, so the only platinum advice is pacing: finish the chapter before detouring, because several activity trophies only unlock once the pair is together [S15][S9].

steps.t: Play the chapter missions in marker order; the chapter ends after the Vice City arrival sequence.
Pick up the first safehouse and garage when offered — Little Boxes (all 8 garages) starts counting from here.
Register any new car you are forced to drive in the Scooter Bros app; On the Spot needs 10 registrations and early cars are easy to forget.
Bank the chapter payout instead of spending it: Treat Yo Self wants $100,000 spent across shops over the whole run, tracked from dollar one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 is the smuggling chapter — it teaches the marked-bills economy that Dime on the Dollar later grinds. The chapter itself is unmissable; what matters is learning the laundering loop now, while the story pays for your mistakes [S38][S15].

steps.t: Complete the chapter's delivery chain; keep every marked bill the story hands you instead of spending it raw.
Unlock your first laundering contact during the chapter and run one small wash to learn the route and the cut.
Note the chapter's boat and plane handovers — Supply & Demand (Randy's strand) reuses both vehicle sets later.
Finish the chapter finale; the trophy pops on the chapter title card, and Chapter 3 opens the Keys in free roam.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the Vice City showcase chapter and the point where the map, the garages and most side systems are all live. From here the guide's Stage 2 clean-up becomes possible, so finish the chapter before starting any long grind [S10][S13].

steps.t: Play the chapter through; it ends with the pair established in Vice City and the full activity menu unlocked.
Visit one of every activity icon that appears (races, range, drone course) — Master of None needs all 9 types touched once.
Start the Collectible Cards hunt in the first district you clear; sets are regional and backtracking is the real time cost.
Buy the cheapest garage on offer to keep Little Boxes moving while prices are still early-game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the mid-game peak — the Mount Kalaga and Ambrosia stretch of the story — and the last chapter before the endgame flags start to matter. Everything up to here is safe to rush; from the next chapter on, check the missable list before each finale [S9][S15].

steps.t: Complete the chapter missions, including the Kalaga ascent; bring a scoped rifle for the ridge sequence.
Photograph wildlife opportunistically on the mountain — Fair Game and the animal compendium grind start easier here than anywhere.
Meditate at the summit spot while you are up here; Positive Mental Attitude needs all 18 spots and this is the easiest one to forget.
Finish the chapter; afterwards, do a first missables pass (partner trophies, VCIA departure) before starting Chapter 5.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.ponr: Starting the final mission locks partner free-roam activities until the post-game — finish Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best first.
trophies.guide: The finale is a long, checkpointed set-piece in several phases, and it is the game's one hard point of no return for partner content: once it starts, the duo activities close until the credits roll and the post-game opens [S9][S41]. Go in with full armour, a stocked wheel and the missables already banked.

steps.t: Before accepting the mission, clear the flagged missables: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best and Catch Me If You Can.
Stock both characters with armour, snacks and max ammo; the finale swaps protagonists and uses both loadouts.
Play the phases in order — the mission cannot be abandoned mid-way, but checkpoints are generous and deaths cost no progress.
Make the ending choice when it comes; either ending earns the trophy, and the post-game reopens the map for the 100% cleanup.
After the credits, save immediately in a fresh slot — this save is the base for every remaining grind in the roadmap.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early errand mission built around a timed drive and a short tail sequence. It is short and replayable from the mission menu, so a scruffy first run costs nothing [S15].

steps.t: Accept the mission at the diner marker and take the marked car — its handling is tuned for the route.
Follow the GPS line rather than shortcuts; the tail sequence triggers on the scripted route, not the clock.
Lose the tail by breaking line of sight in the alley section instead of outrunning it on the boulevard.
Deliver the car intact to finish; the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the first full heist: a prep choice, a loud-or-quiet entry and a two-character escape. Your approach here teaches the exact loop Maximum Withdrawal repeats at five bank vaults, so learn the quiet route properly [S30][S36].

steps.t: Do both prep missions — the extra prep unlocks the quiet entry and a cleaner escape vehicle.
Choose the quiet approach on a first run: it is slower but teaches guard routes you will reuse at the vaults.
During the escape, switch to the partner for the roadblock — their position spawns with the better angle.
Shake the wanted level in the drainage canals south of the bank rather than on open road.
Finish the fence meeting to close the heist; the trophy pops when the take is split.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a character mission with a protection sequence in the middle. Nothing in it is missable, but its escort AI is the same one the partner trophies rely on, so it doubles as practice for Retail Therapy [S15][S41].

steps.t: Start the mission from the house marker and keep the escort target in sight during the drive section.
In the protection sequence, hold the doorway rather than chasing spawns — enemies path to the target, not to you.
Use Combat Focus for the final wave; five downs in one use also progresses Gunslinger if the group is tight.
Complete the closing drive; the trophy unlocks at the mission pass screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the media-tower mission — a vertical fight up a Vice City high-rise ending in a helicopter beat. Bring a carbine and armour; the stairwell sections punish shotguns [S36][S15].

steps.t: Enter through the service garage when offered; it skips the lobby fight entirely.
Clear floor by floor and loot armour pickups — there are two, on the mid-floor landing and the studio level.
For the helicopter beat, use the marked launcher rather than small arms; three hits end the phase.
Finish the rooftop escape to complete the mission and unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport mission, and it shares its window with the missable Catch Me If You Can: during this mission's escape phase you can make the unscheduled departure that trophy wants. Do the departure first, then finish the mission normally [S22][S9].

steps.t: Infiltrate via the cargo gate in a service vehicle; the frontal checkpoint raises the alarm two phases early.
During the escape phase, divert to the light-aircraft apron and take off without a clearance call — that is Catch Me If You Can, and it is only scripted here.
Return to the mission area (or reload the checkpoint after the trophy pops) and complete the takedown as scripted.
Escape the airfield perimeter to finish; Hi-Jacked pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the hardest story mission in the list — a long compound assault with a vehicle finale. It is also where Challenging Tank is most naturally earned, since the assault brings armour onto the field [S36][S30].

steps.t: Approach the compound at night in-game; guard vision cones shrink and the stealth opening lasts longer.
When the Rhinos roll in, let them come to the marked anti-armour cache rather than engaging on foot in the open.
Surviving the Rhino section without dying also banks progress habits for the no-damage attempts later — stay in hard cover.
Complete the vehicle finale and the extraction to finish the mission and the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold is a checklist, not a challenge: story, all stranger strands, the activity golds, the collectible sets and the map itself. The in-game 100% menu is the source of truth — this app's tracker mirrors it category by category so the two never disagree [S35][S13].

steps.t: Finish the story and all 8 stranger strands first; they are the largest single block of the percentage.
Clear the activity requirements: 250 stunts, all range golds, one win at every drone course, 20 race wins, 50 challenges.
Complete the collectible block: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored.
Buy all 8 garages and finish the money trophies; property purchases count toward the percentage.
Use the in-game completion menu to find the final fraction — the usual stragglers are one meditation spot and one stunt.
At 100% the trophy pops immediately, and with it, if it is your last, Vice Got a Price! follows on the same screen.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 250 stunts sounds like a grind and is one — but stunts cluster. Work region by region with the community stunt map and a fast bike, and the count falls in evenings, not weeks; failed landings do not count, clean ones always do [S24][S10].

steps.t: Unlock stunts by attempting any marked ramp; the counter and the map pins appear from the first attempt.
Run the Vice City beachfront cluster first — 40+ stunts in one district, most landable in a mid-tier sports car.
Switch to a fast motorcycle for the Keys causeway jumps; the landings are narrower but the resets are instant.
Save the Mount Kalaga cliff stunts for last and bring a parachute-equipped character build for the bail-outs.
Track the count in the stats menu, not by pins — a handful of stunts are unmarked and only the counter sees them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one attempt each — you do not need to win, place or finish well, just start each type once. It is the cheapest trophy in the game and the natural first stop after Chapter 3 opens the menu [S13][S25].

steps.t: Touch a street race, a Shooting Range challenge and a Top Fun drone race — three of the nine in one Vice City loop.
Add fishing, an arcade game and a meditation spot; all three sit within a short drive of the beachfront.
Start a stunt, a bounty-style challenge from the challenges board, and a hunting trip with Bret to complete the set.
If the trophy does not pop, check the activities menu — the type most often missed is the arcade, which needs a finished game, not a started one.
The trophy unlocks when the ninth distinct type registers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 range challenges at gold is the list's real skill gate. The trick is that gold is about accuracy streaks, not speed: slow down, learn each weapon's recoil ladder, and gold the pistol and rifle families first because their techniques carry the rest [S23][S36].

steps.t: Start with the pistol family and learn the streak system — consecutive hits raise the multiplier that gold scores depend on.
Gold the assault rifle set next; burst-fire in threes and never hold the trigger on the long-range lanes.
For the moving-target challenges, aim at the lane's centre and let targets cross your sight instead of tracking them.
Save the sniper and heavy sets for last, with aim sensitivity lowered one notch in settings for the fine adjustments.
The 42nd gold ends the grind; the trophy pops on the results screen of the final challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: A win — not a finish — at all 14 drone courses. The AI is beatable once you learn that gates, not straights, decide these races: brake before the tight gate pairs and boost only on the long harbour runs [S25].

steps.t: Win the Ocean Beach opener first; it teaches the gate order and has the gentlest AI on the circuit.
Work through the harbour and downtown courses next, cutting inside on the buoy turns.
For the Kalaga and Grassrivers courses, fly the route once in free practice — both hide a shortcut gate behind foliage.
If a win keeps slipping, restart rather than finishing: a restart costs seconds, a lost race costs the whole run.
The 14th location win unlocks the trophy at the results screen.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty DIFFERENT race wins — repeating one easy circuit twenty times does nothing. Bring a tuned car in each class and sweep the map district by district; the street races are shorter and softer than the organised series [S13][S31].

steps.t: Win the three tutorial-grade street races in Vice City to learn the rubber-banding: the AI is fastest when you are.
Keep one tuned car per class (sports, muscle, SUV, bike) — entering under-classed is the main cause of losses.
Sweep district by district so travel time doubles as collectible time; card spawns sit on several race routes.
The wins counter lives in the stats menu; at 20 distinct wins the trophy unlocks after the final race's payout screen.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's challenge is a weight contest at his Keys fishing spot: you need the heavier total when the timer ends, not the rarest fish. Fish the deep channel at dawn with the best bait you own and ignore the small fry entirely [S33].

steps.t: Meet Cal at his dock on the Keys and accept the challenge after buying the upgraded rod and deep-water bait.
Start the contest at dawn in-game; the heavy species bite in the first two hours of light.
Cast to the dark water past the channel marker — that is where the scoring fish hold.
Release anything under the mid-weight band immediately; reeling small fish burns the clock you need for a heavy one.
Beat Cal's total at the weigh-in and the trophy pops on the results card.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet, one full game, start to game-over screen. The beachfront arcade's racing cabinet is the fastest clear; starting a game is not enough — Master of None makes the same distinction [S13].

steps.t: Enter the Ocean Beach arcade and pick the racing cabinet — its game loop is the shortest in the building.
Play to the game-over screen; quitting from the pause menu does not register as a completed game.
The trophy pops as the high-score table appears.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is a chain of recovery-themed errands that escalates into one long protection finale. Strands unlock in order and each next mission appears a day after the last — sleep at a safehouse to advance the clock instead of waiting [S29].

steps.t: Meet Andy at the community centre marker after Chapter 2 and accept the first errand.
Work the strand in order; if a marker does not appear, sleep once — strand steps are gated on in-game days.
Bring a four-door car to the finale; the strand ends with a multi-passenger extraction.
Complete the final mission and the trophy pops at its pass screen; the strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand runs on the water — boat deliveries around the Keys ending in a storm finale. Own the fastest boat you can afford before the last mission; the finale is timed and the stock boat is marginal [S29][S33].

steps.t: Start Kenton's strand at the marina marker on the Keys and complete the delivery chain in order.
Buy or steal a performance boat before the finale and store it at the marina so the mission spawns you in it.
In the storm finale, run the channel markers rather than open water — the marked line avoids the worst wave sets.
Dock at the final marker to finish the strand; trophy and the Strangers & Freaks progress land together.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is the Kelly County biker chain — long road escorts through ambush country. A armoured car trivialises the escorts; doing them on a bike, as the strand suggests, is the hard way and earns nothing extra [S29][S36].

steps.t: Pick up Billy's first job at the Kelly County clubhouse after Chapter 3.
Run the escorts in an armoured four-door; the ambushes target the rider, and a car makes you the wrong kind of target.
Keep the convoy together — straying too far from Billy's bike fails the escort even if you survive.
Finish the final ride-out to close the strand and unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The silver for finishing eight stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone have named trophies of their own, and the remaining strands are found by their question-mark markers across Leonida. Strands are the second-biggest block of the 100% checklist after the story [S29][S35].

steps.t: Finish the five named strands first (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) — each also pays its own bronze.
Sweep the question-mark markers region by region for the remaining strands; new ones appear as chapters advance.
If a strand stalls, sleep twice — several strands gate their next step on two in-game days, not one.
Track the strand count in the completion menu; strands, not individual missions, are what the counter reads.
The eighth completed strand unlocks the silver at that strand's final pass screen.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is the smuggling chain — the same planes and boats Chapter 2 taught, run as timed deliveries with heat attached. It is also the best rehearsal for the laundering economy, since Randy pays partly in marked bills [S29][S38].

steps.t: Start Randy's chain at the airstrip marker once Chapter 2 is complete.
Fly the low route under the radar line shown on the minimap; climbing early is what brings the interceptors.
Wash Randy's marked-bill payments through your laundering contact instead of spending them — they count toward Dime on the Dollar.
Complete the final delivery to close the strand and unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is the street-racing chain — a ladder of rivals ending in a pink-slip finale. Every win here is also a distinct race win, so this strand pays double progress toward Earn Cash, Not Kudos [S29][S13].

steps.t: Meet Tyrone at the Catalan Boulevard meet after Chapter 3 and win the opener to enter the ladder.
Climb the ladder in order; bring the class the meet specifies, not your fastest car overall.
Before the finale, fully tune your car — the pink-slip race is the one street race the AI does not rubber-band kindly.
Win the finale to close the strand; the trophy pops with the keys handover.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: All 18 meditation spots — quiet viewpoints scattered over the map, each a short sit-and-breathe interaction. They are unmarked until you are close, so work from the spot map and tick them off region by region [S28][S14].

steps.t: Start with the Mount Kalaga summit spot during Chapter 4 — it is the one everyone forgets and the longest trip back.
Sweep the Keys and the Grassrivers spots by boat; half of them sit on islets with no road access.
Sit through the full animation at each spot — standing up early does not register the visit.
Check the counter in the stats menu at 17: the last spot is usually the Watson Bay overlook, hidden behind the lighthouse path.
The 18th spot unlocks the trophy as the meditation ends.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's unique animal is a scripted legendary hunt in the Grassrivers — a tracker sequence, not a random spawn. Go at dawn, with the scoped rifle, and follow the sign chain instead of roaming [S32].

steps.t: Take the job from Bret at his camp and examine the first sign he marks — the hunt is a chain of clues, not a search.
Follow the tracks in order; each examined sign narrows the animal's territory on your map.
Make the final approach downwind and crouched — the animal spooks once, and a spooked hunt resets to the last sign.
Take the shot with the scoped rifle and return the pelt to Bret to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Cards come in themed regional sets; you need three FULL sets, not three cards. Pick the three shortest sets on the tracker and clear them district by district — half-finishing six sets is the classic way to stall this silver [S26][S14].

steps.t: Open the cards menu and choose your three target sets — the tracker lists set sizes; take the three smallest.
Collect with the map filtered to one district at a time; cards glow at night, so night runs are visibly faster.
Buy the pawn-shop hint for any card that will not spawn — a few are interior cards that only appear during open hours.
Complete set one, then two, then three; each completed set shows in the collection menu with its reward.
The third completed set unlocks the silver immediately.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are the game's spray-tag locations: find the marked wall, hold the prompt, done. 100 of them is a map-completion exercise — the community map is the difference between a weekend and a month [S27][S14].

steps.t: Trigger your first WAiNK at any glowing wall tag in Vice City to start the counter and the map legend.
Clear Vice City's districts first — the density is highest there and most spots are reachable in one loop.
Take the Keys and Kelly County spots on the same trips as the card sets; the two collectibles share most routes.
For rooftop spots, check the fire escapes — several 'missing' tags are one floor up, not bugged.
The 100th tag unlocks the silver as the animation finishes.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: The challenges board mixes driving, combat, exploration and economy tasks, most of them short. Fifty sounds like a lot until you notice how many complete themselves during the other grinds — check the board before every session and pin the near-done ones [S13][S35].

steps.t: Open the challenges board from the pause menu and pin three at a time — pinned challenges track on the HUD.
Let the ambient ones (distance driven, vehicles discovered, money spent) complete themselves during other trophies.
Actively farm the short combat and driving challenges in free roam; most take under two minutes each.
If the count stalls in the 40s, the board's second page holds the stranger- and property-linked challenges players miss.
The 50th completed challenge unlocks the trophy from the board screen.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.ponr: Partner free-roam closes while the final mission runs — earn this before starting the finale, or in the post-game.
trophies.guide: A duo trophy: with your partner beside you (the other protagonist in free roam, or a co-op partner), raise four stars and lose them together. The catch is that both of you must stay in the escape — splitting up voids it [S41]. Flagged missable only because the finale closes partner free-roam until the post-game.

steps.t: In free roam, switch to duo control or invite your co-op partner and stay in the same vehicle.
Raise a 4-star wanted level in a dense district — vehicle crime in downtown Vice City gets there fastest.
Break line of sight together and hide in the port container yards; do not separate, the trophy tracks the pair.
When the stars clear with both of you still together, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.ponr: Needs partner free-roam — do it before the final mission or in the post-game.
trophies.guide: Three shop robberies in one unbroken wanted chain, with your partner. The chain breaks if the stars fully clear, so the art is robbing close-together shops and moving between them while the heat is still on [S41][S30].

steps.t: Pick three shops on one downtown block — the Ocean Drive strip has three within a two-minute drive.
Rob shop one with your partner inside with you; take the till money and leave while the first stars are still flashing.
Drive directly to shops two and three without hiding — losing the wanted level between shops resets the chain.
After the third till, escape properly; the trophy pops once the chain resolves with the level finally lost.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in it. 100 distinct models sounds steep until you work the rich districts, the docks and the airport, where the rare spawns rotate — this one mostly earns itself if you steal promiscuously [S31].

steps.t: Get into every new model you see during the story; the discovery toast names each first-time vehicle.
Farm the Vice City marina and airport parking rotations — both cycle rare models on a timer.
Check the vehicle database in the app of your in-game phone; it lists undiscovered models by class so you can hunt the gaps.
The 100th distinct vehicle unlocks the trophy as you sit down in it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five downs inside one Combat Focus window. You need a full meter and a grouped enemy set — gang operations and the Savage Glory assault are the natural spots; a shotgun at close range is the reliable tool [S41][S43].

steps.t: Fill the Combat Focus meter fully before attempting — a partial meter shortens the window below five targets.
Pick a grouped set: a gang operation courtyard or the Child's Play final wave both cluster five or more enemies.
Trigger Focus, then work nearest-to-farthest with a shotgun or SMG — body shots count, headshots are not required.
The fifth down inside the same window unlocks the trophy immediately.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.ponr: The scripted departure window is during VCIA Takedown — if you finish that mission without it, use mission replay to reopen the window.
trophies.guide: The one genuinely missable-flavoured trophy: during VCIA Takedown's escape phase, a light aircraft on the apron can be taken off without clearance, and that departure is the trophy. Finish the mission without it and the window closes until you use mission replay [S22][S9].

steps.t: During VCIA Takedown, reach the escape phase and break toward the light-aircraft apron instead of the marked exit.
Board the marked light aircraft and take off without calling the tower — the departure must be unscheduled.
Clear the airfield boundary in the air; the trophy pops as you leave VCIA airspace.
Missed it? Replay VCIA Takedown from the mission menu — the window reopens identically, which is why this is flagged missable-with-recovery.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The vague description hides a simple task: survive an encounter with Rhino tanks — they appear in Operation Savage Glory and at high wanted levels in the post-game. You do not need to destroy one; lasting the encounter and escaping the zone earns it [S30][S41].

steps.t: Reach the Rhino phase of Operation Savage Glory, or raise a top-end wanted level in the post-game until armour deploys.
Stay in hard cover and let the marked anti-armour cache do the work — small arms do nothing to a Rhino.
When the encounter script ends (or you break the zone), the trophy pops — dying after the script resolves still counts.
If it does not pop in the story mission, the post-game wanted route is repeatable on demand.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job: in, cases emptied, out — with the detection meter never filling. Go at night, through the back, with a suppressed weapon only as a last resort; an undetected robbery raises no wanted level at all [S30].

steps.t: Scout the Ocean Drive jewelry store in daylight: note the rear door, the camera positions and the guard rotation.
Return after midnight in-game and enter from the rear alley; disable the camera by its junction box, not by shooting it.
Empty the cases while crouched and watch the detection meter — if it starts filling, freeze until it drains.
Leave by the rear door and walk, do not run, to a vehicle two streets away; the trophy pops once you clear the block undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five full vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape. The Cartel Heist taught the loop; the vaults add a drill timer and a heavier response. Prep each one — an unprepped vault is a shootout, and shootouts fail the escape more often than the drill does [S30][S36].

steps.t: Unlock vaults by finishing The Cartel Heist, then case the first bank: entry, vault door, rear exit, getaway parking.
Run the prep for each vault (drill, disguises or driver) — prepped vaults cut the response by a full wave.
During the drill, hold the lobby with one character and drill with the other; swapping mid-drill restarts the timer.
Escape through the rear and change vehicles once — the second car is what actually breaks the tail.
Repeat at five different banks; re-robbing the same vault does not advance the counter.
The fifth clean escape unlocks the silver at the moment the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run fixed cash routes in free roam. The blitz play is doors-first: stop the truck, breach the rear doors with a sticky charge, take the cash and be gone before the escort logic escalates [S30].

steps.t: Find a truck on its downtown route (they spawn near banks in the morning in-game) and follow at a distance.
Block the truck in a side street, place a sticky charge on the rear doors and step back before detonating.
Grab the cash cases, get in your car and take the first alley — the wanted level is short if you never fire a shot.
Lose the heat; the trophy pops when the escape completes with the cash kept.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: All 52 named areas entered at least once. Most fall to the story and the collectible routes; the stubborn ones are the small rural and island areas nothing else visits. A plane and a slow lap of the map edges finish it [S10][S14].

steps.t: Let the story, strands and collectible routes reveal most of the map naturally before hunting this directly.
Compare your map against the 52-area list in the completion menu — unvisited areas are named there, not just shaded.
Take a plane for the island and swamp areas; several count as entered only on foot, so land and step out.
The 52nd area unlocks the trophy the moment its name banner appears.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, one robbed operation each. Operations are marked once discovered; robbing means taking the operation's cash or product and getting out — wiping the place is optional and usually slower [S34].

steps.t: Discover operations by exploring gang turf; each gang's first operation you find is pinned to the map permanently.
Rob one operation per gang, tracking the gang list in the stats menu — the counter is per gang, not per robbery.
Go in quiet where the layout allows: an undetected take still counts and skips the reinforcement waves.
Expect retaliation visits after the fifth gang — they are free combat, not a fail state.
The ninth gang's operation completes the set and unlocks the trophy on the escape.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The softest trophy in the game: buy a cocktail at the Ocean Beach rooftop bar and drink it at the rail. It is available from the moment Vice City opens — the 'beginning' is the joke, not a time limit [S10]. Long flagged missable in early lists; it is not — see dispute D7 in this guide's audit.

steps.t: Go to the rooftop bar on Ocean Beach in Vice City, any time after the city opens.
Order a cocktail at the bar and carry it to the marked viewpoint rail.
Use the drink prompt and let the short scene play out; the trophy pops as the glass empties.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A series-tradition gag trophy: steal a car from inside the downtown showroom and leave through the glass, not the door. Any showroom car works; the style is in the exit [S31].

steps.t: Enter the downtown vehicle showroom and get into any display car.
Drive straight out through the front glass at speed — using the door or the ramp does not count.
The trophy pops as the car lands on the street; the wanted level afterwards is your own problem.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley, with the follow-through mechanic used as the game teaches it. You do not need to win — the trophy is for playing it through properly, another series in-joke [S13].

steps.t: Enter the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and start a solo game at the counter.
Use the follow-through swing the tutorial shows on every throw — checked per frame, not per result.
Finish all ten frames; the trophy pops on the final scorecard.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.ponr: The partnership scene is a one-time story beat in the middle chapters — if you pass it, mission replay restores it.
trophies.guide: The vaguest description in the list hides a story beat: during the mid-chapter partnership scene, take the photo opportunity the game offers (the pair, the crowd, the view) instead of walking past the prompt. It is a one-time beat in the moment, recoverable later through mission replay [S15][S37].

steps.t: In the mid-chapter beachfront scene, stop at the photo prompt when the crowd gathers instead of following the objective marker.
Take the photo with both protagonists in frame; the trophy pops when the scene resumes.
Already past it? Replay the chapter mission from the menu — the beat and the prompt return exactly as scripted.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 choices for this one — dialogue picks, approach selections, spare-or-kill beats, purchase decisions. It completes through ordinary play long before the platinum if you never skip optional conversations [S37].

steps.t: Take every optional conversation and approach choice the story offers; each registers on the hidden counter.
In free roam, resolve random events with a choice (help, rob, ignore) rather than driving past them.
If the counter is short late-game, stranger replays and approach-selectable robberies are the fastest repeatable choices.
The 500th registered choice unlocks the trophy silently — check the counter in the stats menu if you are close.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.ponr: Tied to failing then re-attempting a timed story beat — if you ace everything first try, deliberately replay and fail once to set it up.
trophies.guide: Fail a timed story beat, then succeed on the immediate retry. The game tracks the fail-then-pass pair; players who never fail have to manufacture it, which is why this carries a missable flag despite mission replay existing [S37][S9].

steps.t: Reach any timed story beat (Breakfast Run's drive is the earliest) and deliberately let the timer expire once.
Choose retry from the fail screen — not reload, not restart from the menu; the pair must be consecutive.
Complete the beat on the second attempt; the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.ponr: A rare night event in the Grassrivers — farmable in the post-game, but missable in practice if you never roam there at night.
trophies.guide: Witness the Grassrivers lights — a scripted strange event that only occurs on clear nights in the swamp, roughly between midnight and 3 a.m. It is farmable forever in the post-game, but nothing in normal play takes you there at that hour, so it is flagged [S32][S9].

steps.t: Go to the Grassrivers boardwalk area on a clear night after midnight in-game.
Wait on foot, not in a vehicle — the event triggers for a pedestrian witness and despawns if you drive at it.
Watch the full sequence without skipping; the trophy pops when the lights leave.
No show by 3 a.m.? Sleep to the next night and return — the event is on a multi-night rotation, see dispute D19.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle — the drive-by melee, not a collision. Speed matters less than the swing connecting: ride the beachfront promenade where pedestrians bunch [S41].

steps.t: Get on a motorcycle — the melee drive-by swing is a bike and car-window move, and the bike is far easier to line up.
Ride slowly along the Ocean Beach promenade and swing as you pass a pedestrian; the hit must be the weapon, not the bike.
A clean knockdown pops the trophy on contact; a collision kill does not count and just adds stars.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A quarter million dollars washed through your laundering contacts. Marked bills come from heists, vaults and Randy's strand; the wash takes a cut but the trophy counts the gross amount you put in, not what comes back [S38].

steps.t: Unlock laundering in Chapter 2 and never spend marked bills raw — raw spending does not count and wastes the stock.
Feed the wash from income that pays in marked bills: vault robberies, gang operations and Randy's deliveries.
Run washes in the largest batches your contact allows; the counter tracks cumulative input across all washes.
The wash that carries the total past $250,000 unlocks the trophy at the handover.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend — not earn, not hold — $100,000 across all shops combined: clothes, weapons, vehicle mods, boats, services. It lands naturally by the money stage; if it lags, vehicle customisation is the fastest sink [S39][S31].

steps.t: Spend normally from Chapter 1 on; every shop till in the game feeds the same counter.
Mid-game, mod one car fully — a top-end custom build is the largest single-shop spend available.
Check the counter in the stats menu before the finale; most players are closer than they think.
The purchase that crosses $100,000 unlocks the trophy at the till.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: All eight garage properties bought — the property ladder from the first Chapter 1 garage to the Port Gellhorn warehouse. Garages also feed the 100% checklist, so this money is never wasted [S39].

steps.t: Buy garages as the story opens new districts; each district's garage is offered at its property marker.
Fund the expensive last two from vault and laundering income in the money stage, not from story payouts.
If a marker is missing, its district story beat has not run yet — garages unlock in step with the map.
The eighth purchase unlocks the trophy at the deed screen.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — the phone app that summons your rides. Any ten distinct vehicles count, including story-issued ones, so register as you go and this is done by Chapter 3 [S40][S31].

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register the first car the story gives you.
Register each new personal vehicle as you acquire it — distinct vehicles count, re-registering the same one does not.
Short on vehicles? Buy two cheap beaters from the in-game listings purely to register and resell.
The tenth registration unlocks the trophy from the app screen.
